markers.label: 18 Jan
markers.detail: Monday 18 Jan 2027, 5pm CET. Nominal date is 15 Jan; that is a Friday, so ESRF moves it to Monday.

tasks.title: Deadline is Monday 18 January 2027, 5pm CET
tasks.note: Checked 1 Nov 2026 on esrf.fr. The standing deadline is 15 January at 5pm CET. If that date falls on a Friday, Saturday, or Sunday, it moves to the following Monday. 15 January 2027 is a Friday, so the filing deadline is Monday 18 January 2027 at 5pm CET. The year table on the site still lists the 2026 call and does not yet have a 2027 row. 10 January is not an ESRF date.
tasks.source: esrf.fr/LTPProposal and the proposal deadlines page, checked 1 Nov 2026

tasks.title: Lock the co-investigator list
tasks.note: The spokesperson must be at an institution in an ESRF member or associate country, and cannot be an ESRF scientist. Jenna has agreed to submit. Everyone else from the meetings is proposed, not confirmed.

tasks.title: Ask ESRF management what a commitment looks like
tasks.note: The 2 Oct action was to ask Montserrat who at ESRF management to approach, and Peter if needed. It is not known whether that conversation happened.

tasks.title: Write the resource-commitment paragraph
tasks.note: The proposal has to say what the group gives ESRF: money, equipment, or staff. No one owns this paragraph yet.
tasks.source: ESRF long-term proposal rules, copied 2 Oct 2026

tasks.title: Agree the aims on one page
tasks.note: The 15 Oct minutes asked Magda, Jenna, and Pegah to scope co-culture before drafting. That assignment is not confirmed. A January to February 2027 beamtime is not written in as committed work.

tasks.title: Name who drafts each section
tasks.note: Jenna files. The team writes. Who names the section drafters is not assigned.

tasks.title: Collect CVs, letters, and A-form material
tasks.note: Starts once the co-investigator list is locked.

tasks.title: Full draft for the team to read
tasks.note: 22 December is a proposed review date, not an agreed one. The draft waits on the aims, the resource paragraph, the co-investigator list, and the decision meeting if the text cites the June run.

tasks.title: Submit the proposal and the A-forms
tasks.note: Jenna submits. File by Monday 18 January 2027, 5pm CET. The nominal ESRF date is 15 January, and in 2027 that is a Friday, so the deadline moves to Monday.

tasks.title: Ask Sandra for the backup and whether she leads LS-3634
tasks.note: The 12 Oct guide set this for mid-November. The report is filed under Sandra. Yentli is co-proposer. Who leads LS-3634 from here is not agreed in the notes. Ask Sandra.

tasks.title: Send the June images, counts, and Excel file
tasks.note: Images, cell and aggregate counts, and the Excel file for HEK, primary neurons, and SH-SY5Y. Unknown as of 1 Nov 2026. Sylvain was away until about 29 Oct.

tasks.title: Confirm backups and download instructions
tasks.note: Sandra holds the main copy. Sylvain was asked for a second copy on the beamline. Download instructions for the co-proposer are not confirmed. Yentli is co-proposer. Who leads LS-3634 from here is not agreed.

tasks.title: Analyze the June run for the proposal
tasks.note: Sandra was going to ask her student. Yentli was going to organize volunteers. Kenneth does not analyze.

tasks.title: Ask how the June results will be used
tasks.note: Ask this once the file is in hand. There is no date. Yentli is the person who already writes to the group.

tasks.title: Ask whether SOP GLAB-BIOH-001 was reviewed after 1 Sep 2026
tasks.note: The Aberdeen SOP was due for review on 1 Sep 2026. It is not known whether that review happened.

tasks.title: Ask who owns the ESRF safety declaration and Form A
tasks.note: Neither is on file for a next beamtime. It is not known who owns them, or whether they wait until a beamtime date exists.
